description: This file defines models and a fetcher for ECB Balance of Payments data, including query parameters, data models, and data extraction logic using asynchronous calls and pandas for data processing.

classes.name: ECBBalanceOfPaymentsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for ECB Balance of Payments query parameters, including report type, frequency, and country.

classes.name: ECBBalanceOfPaymentsData
classes.description: Data model aggregating various ECB balance of payments components.

classes.name: ECBBalanceOfPaymentsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to transform queries, extract data asynchronously, and validate data into models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an ECBBalanceOfPaymentsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches series data from ECB endpoints, processes it into a pandas DataFrame, and returns a list of records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Validates and transforms raw data dictionaries into ECB data models.
